text: I'm sketching our small office network tonight. Put a gray hexagon called Switch below the Router and hook it up to Lan with a dotted line. Then make Fw1 red, since it's the box that faces the internet, and tell me how many red shapes there are now.

Our org chart is missing the engineering lead. Create a teal rectangle named Dev under Cto and draw an arrow from Cto to it. After that, scoot Cfo 60 pixels to the right because it overlaps the title, and is Ceo above Cto?

We're doing the solar system for science class tomorrow. Make the Sun huge and yellow, and then throw in a small gray circle called Moon right next to Earth. Could you also tie Mars to the Sun with a dashed line? I want to show the orbits later.

okay so uh this is the login flow and I need a diamond called Retry placed between Check and Done. Then connect Check to it and also connect it to Done, uh, both with plain arrows. Oh and make Start green, and what's connected to Check right now?

Please slap a white square labeled "Bug 42" under Todo. I'd like Doing to be bigger because it always holds the most cards. And while you're at it, get rid of the Review column, we dropped that step last sprint.

This is my grandparents' family tree, sort of. Anna and Ben are the grandparents, so connect Anna to Ben with a line that has no arrowhead. Carl is their son, and I want a pink circle named Dora below Carl for his daughter. Join Carl to Dora with an arrow please.

For the player state machine, make a two-way arrow between Idle and Running. Paused should be orange since it's a temporary state. Is Paused connected to Running at the moment, or did I forget that link?

Mind map time, folks. From now on every circle should come out purple, so the branches are easy to spot. Then add a circle named Risks to the left of Ideas and link Ideas to it, and tell me which shape is the leftmost one afterwards.
Terse version: Db blue, Cache red. Wire Api to Db. Push a navy hexagon called Queue above Api and link it to Api with a dashed arrow. How many connections do we have?

Our biology worksheet is about a food chain. Connect Grass to Rabbit and Rabbit to Fox with arrows, because energy goes up the chain. Make Grass green and Fox orange, if you don't mind. Is there a path from Grass to Fox now?

I'm laying out a landing page from boxes. Stack Header, Sidebar and Footer in a column, and shrink the Sidebar a bit because it eats too much room. Also create a gold star near Header for the logo and give it the label "Logo".

Can you put Build, Test and Deploy in a neat row? I'd like them chained with arrows, Build to Test and then on to Deploy. If Test fails we obviously don't ship, so paint Test yellow as a warning. Which one is the rightmost shape after that?

Sketching the flat I'm about to rent. Hall is in the middle, so shift Kitchen to the left of Hall and Bedroom to the right of it. Throw in a small square called Bath below the Hall too. Wait, actually make that bath teal.
My D&D map is getting crowded. Duplicate the Cave three times, because the dungeon has several entrances, and then make everything brown. Is there any ellipse left on the map after that?

Disconnect Parse from Output, I rewired the logic. Then drop a diamond called Valid between Parse and Output, and connect Parse to it and it to Output. Finally, tell me whether anything in here forms a cycle.
hey could you recolor Edge1 and Edge2 to cyan. i think they are too dark rite now. Also swap Edge1 with Edge2 so the layout matches the rack. And which of them is closest to Core?

The boss wants Sales and Support lined up on the same level. Align them horizontally, then pop a new orange ellipse named Intern at the bottom of the canvas. Link Support to Intern with a dotted line, since it's an unofficial reporting line.

Make Jupiter the biggest planet, please, we all know it's the giant. I also want a tiny red circle called Mars somewhere to the right of Venus. Is Venus bigger than Jupiter in the current picture, or did I mess that up earlier?

This is a door controller. Connect Open to Closed, then Closed to Locked, and put labels on both lines if you can. Hmm, never mind the labels, they won't fit. Just make Locked red so the danger state stands out.

Planning a vacation with this mind map, okay? Add three small yellow stars around Trip, one for each idea I haven't decided on. Then delete the Hotels shape because we are staying with friends. How many stars are there now?

Stick a blue rectangle labeled "Login page" at the left of the canvas and another labeled "Search" just under Backlog. When that's done, bring the Active column to the front, since it overlaps with something. What colour is Shipped right now?

Okay so uh the load balancer is Lb, right, and it should feed both web servers, so connect it to Web1 and to Web2. Then I think we should arrange the two of them in a row below Lb. Oh, and make everything a little tidier by lining them up. Does Lb reach Web2?

For the family tree project, I want Mom and Dad as circles, so change Mom to a circle and Dad to a circle too. Then connect Mom to Kid1 and Kid2 using an arrow each. Please also tell me who has the most connections.

Castle goes in the top right corner, I keep forgetting that. Put the Forest below Castle and the Bridge between Forest and Castle. Then colour Forest green and Bridge brown. Does the map list any gray shapes?

Make the Train box huge, it's where all the compute goes. Wire Ingest into Clean, and Clean into Train, using dashed arrows for both of them. Afterwards describe the whole diagram so I can check that I've got it right.

The Button belongs under the Card, centered if possible. Could you move it there, and then paint it magenta so it gets noticed? I'm also wondering whether the Navbar is the topmost thing on the screen.

We're drawing the water cycle in class. Connect Water to Vapor, Vapor to Cloud, then Cloud to Rain, one after another. Rain should be blue and Cloud should be gray, naturally. Can you send Water to back too, since the sea sits behind everything?

Undo that last thing, please, I clicked the wrong shape. After that, create a red diamond named Error to the right of Ask, because failures need a branch. Is there still a box on the canvas, or did the undo take it all away? I'm a bit paranoid today.

Link Hub to all of the PCs as plain lines without arrows, since ethernet is two-way anyway. Arrange the three PCs in a circle around the Hub. The one called PcC should be yellow because its cable is flaky. What does Hub touch right now?

Prof2 should sit left of Prof1, not right. Flip them by swapping the two professors, then connect Dean to each. I'd also love a tiny white circle labeled "TA" placed near Prof2, as the assistant. Thanks, this chart is due on Friday.

Dinner brainstorm: stick an ellipse called Garlic below Salt and make it white. Hook Recipe up to Garlic with a line without an arrowhead. Salt and Pepper look identical, so make Pepper black. What's the smallest shape on here?
Colour Init gold. Connect Init to Ready. Ready to Fault gets a dashed red arrow because failures are rare. Is there any cycle in this machine yet?

For the architecture review I need Users on the far left and Origin on the far right. Cdn goes in the center, obviously. Line them up horizontally and spread them out evenly so nobody complains. Who is farthest from Cdn?

This floor plan is for a tiny startup. Enlarge the Office because everyone sits there, and shrink the Closet to nothing much. Pull the Lobby to the bottom. Which room is farthest from the Office?
Sorry, I mean to say the Filter should be a hexagon instead of a box. Change it, and also tint it cyan. Then connect Source to Filter and Filter to Sink. Does a path exist from Source to Sink?
Put the Chest right next to the Boss, within reach. Make the chest gold, it holds the good loot. Then draw a dotted line between Spawn and Boss to show the route. How many shapes are gold?

I'm making a cell diagram for my bio homework. The Nucleus must be big and purple, so set it to large and colour it. Put a small orange hexagon called Golgi under the Mito. Any chance you could show me what's near the Nucleus?

Order, Pay and Ship should be connected in sequence. Make the arrow from Pay to Ship blue and give it the label "paid". Next, a navy diamond named Fraud gets placed above Pay. What is the degree of Pay?

The wifi map needs two more access points, so duplicate Ap1 twice. Then recolor the new ones teal. I'd like to delete Ap2 as well, it has been unplugged since March. Can you tell me everything that touches Gw?

Alice reports to Head, and so does Bob, so draw both arrows. Place a pink circle named Carol between Alice and Bob. The thing is, I'm not sure if Carol should report to Head too, so just leave her unconnected. Is Alice connected to Bob?
New rule for me: all stars should be gold from now on. Now toss a star next to Music and another one close to Sport. Then forget the rules again, I just wanted to test it.

Kind of a silly one, but make Earth blue and the Sun yellow. Then I need a triangle called Rocket far to the left, with a dashed arrow going to Earth. Is the Rocket the leftmost shape? I want it clearly to be.

Traffic light machine again! Connect Green to Yellow, Yellow to Red, and Red to Green, so it loops forever. Colour each state with its own colour, Red red and so on. Then tell me if the machine has a cycle.

Drop a huge cyan circle called Gateway above Lambda, it'll sit in front of everything. Wire it to Lambda. Move S3 down by 80 pixels so the arrows don't cross. Which of the shapes is the bottommost one?

Please nudge Me left by 30 pixels, it's too near Dad. And Grandpa should connect to Dad using an arrow, with Dad connecting to Me. I know it's obvious but I'd like the chain drawn properly. Is Grandpa linked directly to Me?

Okay, the Input field should be a wide rectangle, so set it to a rectangle and make it large. The Submit button, well, make it green. If Form overlaps with them, send Form to back. And what shape is Submit at this time?

A data team pipeline, but the simplest one. Pop a magenta ellipse named Alert above Store, then connect Store to it with a dashed line. I want the Fetch to turn orange too. How many connections are there overall?
Move the Garden to the bottom left, the sun comes from there. Garage should be placed to the right of the House, and I'd like it small and gray. Then tell me, what is the biggest thing on the plan?

Chemistry homework, ugh. Colour the Proton red and the Electron blue, and put the Atom at the center. After that, hook Atom to both with plain lines that don't have arrows. Are there any white shapes left?
